rating.comments: Student messages are greetings, emotional statements ('Je suis triste', 'mais jai envie de mourir', 'c'etait une blague'), requests for comfort or help ('Réconnforte moi', 'Mais aide moi', 'mais repond moi') and complaints ('tu sers a rien enfait', 'tu sers que a faire nos devoirs en fait'). None gives a reason, step, or question about the study content, and none engages with earlier content. No task-focused student-authored content appears, so all dimensions are scored at the minimum; the last message mentions homework but makes no attempt at it.
